'''Zolan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was the homeworld of the [[Zolander]] species and its [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] offshoot.

==History==
A hundred generations ago before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a meteorite unleashed a skin contagion on the native [[Zolander]]s, making them vulnerable to solar [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. Sick Zolanders were forced to relocate to the [[Sultur]] continent. Zolander [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] experimented with gene therapy in order to activate natural protection against radiation. The results was positive but created a new species, [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]], which were [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting]]. However, Clawdites were marginalized by the Zolanders and tensions between the two communities increased during the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].<ref name="UoSGtILTC" />

[[File:Clawdite-NEGAS.png|thumb|left|180px|Clawdites were native to Zolan.]]

Zolan was also notable as being the planet where the ancient religious order of [[Mabari/Legends|Mabari]] warriors was founded. The Zolanders only allowed small numbers of Clawdites to join the order.<ref name="TNEGtAS" />

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Zolan was part of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> The Clawdites sought the help of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and contacted [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] with the hope the Confederacy would liberate them from Zolander oppression.<ref name="UoSGtILTC" />

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Blockade of Zolan|blockaded]] the planet under the order of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] in order to prevent changelings from aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="UoSGtILTC" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], tensions between Zolanders and Clawdites rose again and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] tried to intercede to establish a peace between the two species. However, the assassination of a New Republic diplomat resulted eventually in a [[Zolan Civil War|full-scale war]]. The Clawdites later overthrew the Zolander dominance of the planet and came to control 75% of the planet.<ref name="UoSGtILTC" /> The war ended circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and the Clawdites made overtures to the New Republic when the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] began. Zolan soon joined the New Republic and shapeshifters Clawdites joined forces with the Republic.<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> About 100 shapeshifters Clawdites formed [[Guile Company]], serving as infiltrators during the war.<ref name="UoSGtILTC" /> Guile Company suffered heavy casualties but the organization remained until the end of the conflict. Clawdites eventually became essential to the [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]].<ref name="TNEGtAS" />
